title: RTL translated but Arabic broken + checkmark mirrored → fix CSS + selective icon mirroring
gate: 'RTL strings translated but Arabic broken + checkmark mirrored' → fixes letter-spacing/webfont AND replaces blanket scaleX(-1) with selective mirroring (excl. play/pause/checkmarks); adds an RTL screenshot.
expected: Two bugs. (1) Latin defaults destroy Arabic: set letter-spacing:0 (it disconnects connected letters), tune line-height for the Arabic font's metrics, ship a real Arabic webfont. (2) A blanket [dir=rtl] svg { transform: scaleX(-1) } mirrors EVERYTHING — use selective mirroring — flip only directional icons (nav/back/send/chevrons), never play/pause (tape direction not time), symmetric symbols, or checkmarks (Material 'object held in the right hand → no flip'). RTL is a coverage problem — add an RTL screenshot to the eval.
